title: Feed rough grey 3D blockout scenes (no textures or lighting) into Seedance 2.0…
content: Feed rough grey 3D blockout scenes (no textures or lighting) into Seedance 2.0 to generate finished, fully rendered shots.
tips: Feed rough grey 3D blockout scenes (no textures or lighting) into Seedance 2.0 to generate finished, fully rendered shots.
